dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    gcc \
    g++ \
    libpq-dev \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt \
    && apt-get purge -y gcc g++ \
    && apt-get autoremove -y

COPY . .

CMD ["python", "-c", "print('Apache Beam environment ready')"]
explanation: This configuration provides a complete Apache Beam development environment with pinned versions for stability. The requirements.txt includes all detected imports with compatible versions, using psycopg2-binary for easier installation and apache-beam[gcp] for Google Cloud functionality. The Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim as base, installs system dependencies needed for psycopg2 and compilation, then installs Python packages. It cleans up build dependencies afterward to minimize image size. The CMD provides a simple verification command.
